att_working_model.definition: The set of assumptions a person carries about how other people answer when they reach out.
att_working_model.example: My working model says that people get busy and come back, so I wait.

cv.definition: The document that lists your education and work history. In the United States it is usually called a résumé.
cv.example: I sent my CV and my cover letter on Monday morning.

dpn_social_proof.definition: A pressure tactic that presents the decisions of other people as evidence for your own.
dpn_social_proof.example: The offer came with social proof: nine out of ten customers chose the larger plan.

war_deterrence.definition: The effort to prevent an opponent's action by making the cost of it too high.
war_deterrence.example: Deterrence holds only if the opponent believes both the ability and the will.
